description.en: Everything in DMART is an **Entry** — a single, uniformly addressed unit of information. There are no bespoke tables per feature, no separate "users API" versus "documents API": a user, a folder, a blog post, a support ticket, an uploaded PDF and a system log are all the same shape of object, distinguished only by a `resource_type`. Understand the Entry and its address, and you understand the whole platform.
